title: Birth in Louisville and musical family; self-taught
summary: Born in 1888 in Louisville, his mother's organ and French harp started him; self-taught against his father's disapproval of jazz.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: So I wonder if you could start a little bit at the very beginning, just when you were born and where too.
Yeah. Do you remember that you did anybody else in your family play? Your father, mother, any brothers or anyone play? Yeah.

My mother's where the music came from because she played organ. And also she played, they were what they called a mouth organ. At that time they called it French organ. And she learned me as a kid to play the French organ. I used to play that mouth organ very good. My father and I. And so from that on up, I come in to learn on the organ. From the organ.
The regular organ like the little reed organ.
The one that you pump with your feet. Yeah. One of those that little old house organ. That you pump with your feet.
Did you have any lessons that much or take it up for yourself? No.

Only what I had taken in school. And I was self-taught. Quickly. Because my dad didn't like the idea of it. And he didn't approve of it. And so kids that those days and times with people that was, Christian people, they didn't like nothing. nothing what they called jazz or playing anything. They played some sacred, it was all right. And so that's why I used to have a lot of fun playing the sacred music and turn it into swing, which we called jazz back then, didn't they?
